Pushed for review: **Gerrit change 2658** — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2658 (commit `1748404108c3`, branch `drift-fd2b-eebc`). Carries both this ticket and `jaded-pugnacious-isopod` in `rebar-ticket:` trailers; they share `.github/workflows/terraform-drift.yml`.

Local state before push: `make lint` green (complexity ratchet `new=0 increased=0`, mechanism ratchet `new=0 increased=0`), `make typecheck` green, `make verify` ran the full suite — 19450 passed with 2 failures, both `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py`, caused by the two new mechanisms this change adds; fixed by adding them to `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` alongside their `# mechanism-ok:` markers, then re-run green with the whole workflow/terraform test set (53 passed).

Not closing the ticket — waiting on `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`, and the operator submits.
